title: Public Health paid a fee for a free records-storage service

beats.text: The health department paid a $20 fee for a free service.

visual.sub: A health department invoice included a $20 fee for a free service

beats.text: It appeared on one of five storage invoices auditors checked.
The report also gives two payment totals that differ by $2.
The department also lacked a complete inventory of stored boxes.

visual.kicker: Staff could not reconcile the number of boxes on invoices

beats.text: Staff could not verify the count billed after boxes were removed.

beats.text: A $1 million agreement required annual reports of services.

visual.kicker: The missing annual usage reports distinguished contract work from other services

beats.text: The contract office obtained those reports after auditors asked.

beats.text: City payments to the supplier reached $4.05 million across 41 departments.
